route_title: 7-Layer Cr-Dielectric Stack with Tight Thickness Bounds
compilation_rationale: Fixed seven-layer Cr/HfO2/SiO2/Cr/HfO2/SiO2/Cr stack optimized against air/Al boundaries. Uniform 50 nm initialization with [15, 90] nm hard bounds enforces manufacturing limits instead of quadratic thickness penalties. Objectives prioritize broadband absorption in 400–700 nm and reflectance in 700–2000 nm while suppressing undesired spectral trade-offs. S-matrix solver handles coherent thin-film propagation.
